findings: Increasing the window to 7x7 alone resolves the remaining color-swatch JPEG in this development corpus: linear and encoded modes both accept 20/20.
Encoded 5x5 still accepts only 19/20. A color-space change alone is insufficient here.
Encoded 7x7 has higher matched-window fractions on the color-swatch JPEG than linear 7x7, but numeric tolerances have different units; this is not evidence of general superiority.
Strict linear pixel and unfiltered photometric evidence remain separately exposed. Original filtered API retains linear behavior.
qualification: 80-digit Decimal transfer landmarks cover negative values, threshold, zero and HDR up to +/-10000.
Transfer-before-premultiplication and transfer-before-bilinear interpolation are separately tested; invisible NaN RGB stays ignored.
Independent 17x17 Decimal fixtures qualify encoded gain .7 and offset .02; broad color and alpha changes retain failed windows at 7x7.
One file test qualifies all 20 derivatives and six distinct-scene negatives in each space at 7x7.
